'''Voran Stalton''' was an up-and-coming member of the [[Stalton Syndicate]]. The [[Gender/Legends|man]] became embroiled with a group of adventurers hired by the [[Committee for Renewal]].<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voran Stalton is mentioned in an adaventure seed in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]''.<ref name="DC" />

If the players defeat the Synidcate, Stalton flees.<ref name="DC" />
